inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Button accepts every native <button> attribute (ButtonHTMLAttributes), such as onClick, form or aria-*. The ref is forwarded to the <button> element.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.loading: With isLoading the button is disabled and gets aria-busy and aria-disabled.
a11y.iconOnly: With iconOnly there is no visible text: pass aria-label.
a11y.icons: Icons and the spinner render with aria-hidden.
a11y.type: The default type is "button", so it never submits forms by accident.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on the props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.root: Always applied to the root <button> element.
rules.label: Wraps the text (`children`), except in `iconOnly`.
rules.spinner: Wraps the spinner when `isLoading` is true.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Each variant sets these variables. Redefine them in your own class to change colors without overriding rules.

items.--gem-btn-fg-hover: Text and icon color on hover.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts every native <button> attribute.

items.className: Extra classes, merged with the gem-system ones.
items.isLoading: Shows a spinner and disables the button.
items.children: Button content. For icon-only, pass the icon as children.
items.onHover: Fires when the pointer enters (true) or leaves (false). Not called while disabled or loading.
